about: Authority registry (SPEC 3.2, G5, G9). A source may be primary or institutional only if its url resolves to an entry here whose may_be allows it; G5 counts independence by entry. People review and edit this file; tools and pipeline agents never write it. To propose an entry, see .claude/skills/ihh-verified-facts/SKILL.md (Proposing a registry entry). Scopes (2026-10-10): urls makes a single-record entry; content_part limits an entry to one part of a page (transcription); kind public-university-archive is institutional only on exact hosts. Owner 2026-10-16: supporting_only (a second holder at most, never a fact's sole source), part_of (counted as the parent holder for G5), owner_approved_on.

entries.name: The Collected Papers of Albert Einstein (Einstein Papers Project, Princeton University Press)
entries.note: Owner decision 2026-10-10 (DECISIONS.md 'Scholarly edition and Nature: narrow approvals'): counts ONLY for word-for-word transcriptions of original documents, never editors' notes, introductions, footnotes or commentary; a source must carry content_part 'transcription' and its snapshot must mark the transcribed text. The registry bounds this, not the record: document_paths admits only the original-language volume reader pages /volN-doc/<page> (vol1-vol16, 8a, 8b; no query string). Excluded by path: /volN-trans/ (editors' English translation), bare /volN, /einstein-database/, /api/, images. Evidence (Wayback CDX and a 2018 snapshot of vol1-doc/100, checked 2026-10-10): the site was a Tizra page-image reader; each page is one scanned printed page of the volume (alt text 'Volume 1 ... page 32') with an OCR word layer of undifferentiated spans, so introductions, document headings, texts, footnotes and indexes sit on the same URL shape and cannot be separated by URL or markup. The path scope therefore only excludes whole non-document sections; the owner scope for document text on a -doc page rests on the manual TRANSCRIPTION markers plus the adversary's check that each quote is document text. Institutional, not primary (a transcription is not the original record; a person may decide otherwise). https://einsteinpapers.press.princeton.edu/ answered 200 (redirect to /einstein-database/, title 'Einstein Database - PUP Einstein Database'); TLS certificate CN=einsteinpapers.press.princeton.edu (no organization named). On 2026-10-10 the volume pages (e.g. /vol12-doc/26) redirect to that database announcement, so no transcription was reachable by plain fetch or browser.

entries.name: Nature, volume 107, page 539 (1921)
entries.note: Owner decision 2026-10-10 (DECISIONS.md 'Scholarly edition and Nature: narrow approvals'): ONE item only, the 1921 report 'The National Academy of Sciences, U.S.A.' (Nature 107, 539-540) for the Washington 1921 room. Any other Nature or journal url is unregistered (secondary). https://www.nature.com/articles/107539a0 answered 200 with title 'The National Academy of Sciences, U.S.A. | Nature' after nature.com's cookie redirect; TLS certificate CN=*.nature.com. Institutional, not primary: like the newspaper pages on file, a printed report is not the original record.
